SK9013 The local block overrides a canonical option

A line below # skala:local begin sets a registry option that the canonical block also sets, in the same section, to a different value. Info: this is the mechanism working, and the list is the review artefact. Nothing needs fixing — delete the line to adopt the canonical's value, or keep it and the override survives every bump.

CategoryTool
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.6

Why

The canonical sits on top and the local block below it because later sections win in .editorconfig; that is what lets a repository keep a decision through a bump. The cost is that nobody sees the decisions unless they are listed, so each is, at the file line it lives on, and skala config diff --canonical prints the same list as canonical X -> local Y. The comparison is by exact key spelling within the same section name, falling back to the canonical's [*], because comparing by option identity conflated an alias with a contradiction (SK9005) and [*.csv] with [*], and both misfired on Skala's own configuration.

When it does not fire

Only keys the option registry owns are compared, so a dotnet_diagnostic.* severity the local block pins is not listed here — that is SK9016's territory. It is also computed for an unmanaged file, treating the whole file as the local block, so an un-synced repository sees a preview of what adoption would preserve.
